prompt:
Edit image 1, the approved custom card back, with these specific improvements. Output one 1024x1536 portrait card back. KEEP its pale dusty sage background, ivory border, subdued flat geometric mid-century illustration style, visual hierarchy, eight unique building groups and overall locations. Image 5 (original Machi Koro backs) reinforces the required quiet schematic style. Images 2-4 provide structural details ONLY, not their realistic shading or complexity. Do not turn the card into a realistic illustrated town.

1 RAILWAY STATION, middle left: preserve the train, gabled station, arched windows and clock. Add the authentic stylized red РЖД logo on the facade above the entrance, using image 4 as logo reference. Fit both clock and logo cleanly by moving the small clock to the wall beside the doorway if necessary. Make the station visibly worn: a few broad flat patches of missing cream plaster revealing faded brick, crooked gutter, desaturated rusty roof patches, chipped base. Graphic restrained marks rather than photorealistic texture. On the bench on the right of the station, seated elderly grandmother with headscarf and long coat; next to her on the ground an upright plaid wheeled shopping trolley bag with clearly visible handle and two wheels. Keep her small but readable, comparable to the station door in scale.
2 REFINERY, upper right: redesign its process equipment to resemble a credible refinery rather than disconnected decorative tubes. Use image 2 for structural cues: metal distillation columns of different heights with segmented bands, small access platforms and yellow guardrails, slender ladder or support structure, connected horizontal pipe racks, right-angle pipe bends actually linking vessels, two storage tanks, compact lower processing structures. Simplify this into flat blue-gray graphic shapes with subdued ochre details. Architectural and mechanical plausibility, not photorealism. Keep approximately the same overall footprint and generous breathing room. Add one small white flag on a slim pole with the recognizable black and ochre Rosneft emblem from image 2, no wordmark needed. Pole within the refinery footprint; flag smaller than the tallest tower and not touching border.
3 GARAGES, middle left: retain the three garage bays and parked gray Volga. In the OPEN central garage replace the workbench with a small faded brown sofa and a burgundy patterned wall rug behind it, tiny cream diamond motifs sufficient. Open dark green doors and warm muted interior, no glow effect. Make sofa and rug legible as cozy garage living room.
4 BOTTOM LEFT: completely replace the karaoke building with ONE charming small WOODEN ORTHODOX CHURCH inspired by image 3: warm muted brown timber walls indicated with a few horizontal log lines, stepped gray pitched roof, one gold onion dome with cross, tiny arched windows, gabled porch and small timber fence/gate. Fit within the old karaoke area, narrow enough for visible path around it. Render in the SAME flat geometric style as all the other buildings. No cars, priest or other people from church reference. Remove all karaoke microphone symbols.
5 ROAD REPAIR: eliminate the isolated rounded loop around the three trees at center-right (between mall and tower). Leave simple sparse trees on plain ground there, without enclosing road. Redraw only necessary road connections to make ONE coherent connected city road network, thin ivory line of same weight as original. In particular the road from the new church doorway must connect visibly into the existing main network, not trail off into nowhere at the bottom. Use a short path from church entrance to the bottom-right main-road segment beside the TV center, with a clean continuous junction. Every road branch must join the network or end at an actual entrance/parking area. No disconnected road loops, no arbitrary dangling ends, no roads through buildings. Existing railway remains distinct.
Preserve the panel house and its two white swans, small shawarma and small spit, pyramid shopping center, TV tower and broadcast center. Preserve their placement and appearances closely. No repeated buildings. Keep a quiet soft desaturated palette and flat illustrated shapes, slight paper grain, minimum outlines, no realistic lighting/shadows, no extra buildings, no title or captions. Only permitted lettering is the РЖД logo. Rosneft flag uses its pictogram. This is a restrained playing-card back.
